`_from_xarray` now unconditionally calls `unflatten_snapshots(da)`, without checking linopy semantics or the snapshot-index option. For an array with a flat object-valued snapshot index containing `(period, timestep)` tuples, this converts the index to a MultiIndex before the existing conversion logic, whereas the base commit leaves it flat. Thus the returned snapshot indexing can differ even under legacy semantics with the default or `"multiindex"` option.
